QuestInfo.name: [Labyrinth of Suffering] Fire the Signal Flare
QuestInfo.0: You are in a situation where it's difficult to move on your own. Fire a signal flare and request support from the main base.
QuestInfo.1: You are in a situation where it's difficult to move on your own. Fire a signal flare and request support from the main base.
QuestInfo.2: You fired the signal flare, but it disappeared as if swallowed by the darkness. Moreover, the entire search party went missing except for one person... and he seems to be out of his mind.
